digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify corpus and Pandoc integration testing
propositions: Complete live-Pandoc corpus replay on every Gerrit Verify cell contributes a measured 184.32-second macOS performance penalty that must be moved out of the per-change hot path while retaining all behavioral and contractual assertions.

A static converter backed by committed deterministic Pandoc artifacts and representative evidence-selected live bodies can replace broad corpus replay in routine Verify while maintaining fail-closed safety, version/platform/argv/stdin/timeout probes, and complete real-Pandoc replay in an external weekly/manual job.

Fixture regeneration, validation, and external replay orchestration must be deterministic, non-writing-checkable, and cover all 178 bodies and 1,383 ordered settling conversions across code_arrow, table, and prose strata.

The implementation must retain every existing corpus assertion class, every supported Python and operating-system matrix cell, and all production behavior while reducing focused same-host wall time from 42 seconds to 4 seconds (90.8% reduction).
